segment: The second power loss is survived: the composition, the data and the receiver came back, and the four cases executed after the layer are intact

the_outage.the_host: powered down and restarted; the uptime counter read about eighteen minutes at the time of this record

what_came_back_clean.the_receiver: hermes-gateway-1b7e7667.service is active with a NEW pid 2746 (it was 69832 before the outage), one process, Telegram connected in polling mode, served_profiles [default, dest_telegram, telegram-bot-8812646969]
what_came_back_clean.the_composition: 185 layers and the layer bounded-resume-sidecar-guard among them; agent/bounded_context.py is sha256 1acfe925ed92921e... and carries the fix; the plugin inventory matches the marker (51 of 51); the marker and the source receipt agree
what_came_back_clean.the_data: dest_telegram 196 messages and telegram-bot-8812646969 5108 messages, integrity_check ok on both
what_came_back_clean.the_providers: the model endpoint on :30000, the embeddings on :8002 and the compression dispatcher on :8001 answer again

the_outage.what_was_lost: nothing in the composition or in the data

the_state_after_the_outage: all four runs keep their observation and their acceptance; the outage touched none of them
not_repeated: the runs that never reached the wire sent nothing: d07-compare-v1-v2-check-01-r63 was refused before the send for a scenario that lacked the pinned tester id, and r65 and r66 were refused in the preflight by a transport uncertainty, both PREPARED. Only r67 carried the comparison request to the wire.
